## Summary

Graduated in Statistics from the Federal University of Juiz de Fora.

Professional experienced in R, Python, AWS, and SQL, working on the development of RShiny applications and building data pipelines for inferential and predictive modeling.

Extensive experience in Machine Learning and Deep Learning for epidemiological forecasting.
